Binaural beats, incense, salt around the neck. Not one wealthy guy used them.

Kevin Trudeau describes a private retreat with 35 very wealthy men. He asked who meditates, who listens to binaural beats, who burns incense. They laughed.

His point is simple. These are things people promote as bringing prosperity, yet not one person in that room did any of them. If they work, he asks, how come none of them use them?

Which habit do you keep because it feels right, not because it works?
